title: Sticker Peel
description: A used copy of Abbey Road from a record shop, ring-worn and soft at the corners, with one price sticker whose corner has started to lift. Peel it from the edge: it curls back over a moving fold, the glue pulls into strands that thin and snap, and the sleeve keeps the residue. Swap the sleeve for Revolver, Let It Be or Help!.
intent: One tactile act finished to the edge: a sticker that peels like paper and glue, not like a UI layer
